mechanism: Betamethasone impairs glucose control and may reduce the efficacy of empagliflozin through gluconeogenesis and insulin resistance, while empagliflozin increases euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis risk with corticosteroid use.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely; may require dose adjustment of empagliflozin or increased frequency of glycemic monitoring during corticosteroid therapy; consider alternative agents if possible.
